吴姜将自身修为发挥到极致，左手玄冥幽光不断甩出，一道道黑色光束与刘奎逸散的煞气碰撞在一起，发出滋滋的刺耳声响，火星四溅。

一时间，整个刘家祖坟所在的山丘上，阴风呼啸，鬼气翻涌，打斗的闷响在寂静的深夜里格外刺耳，惊得远处的夜鸟纷纷扑棱着翅膀逃窜。

又是一次硬拼，吴姜借着反作用力将刘奎逼退，趁他身形未稳之际，手一翻，掌心瞬间多了一沓泛黄的符箓，也不细看符箓种类，一股脑朝着刘奎扔了过去。

只听噼里啪啦一阵脆响，符箓落地即燃，金色的符火与刘奎周身的黑气剧烈反应，冒出阵阵黑烟，灼烧得刘奎发出一声凄厉的嘶吼，煞气也消散了几分。

吴姜眼神一凝，暗中蓄力，将玄冥幽光尽数灌注到斩魂剑上，剑身上的幽冥剑气瞬间暴涨，泛着刺眼的幽蓝光芒。

趁着刘奎挥刀驱散符火的间隙，吴姜身形一闪，欺身而上，手中斩魂剑带着毁天灭地的气势，狠狠朝着刘奎的胸口刺去。

刘奎瞳孔骤缩，想要躲闪已然来不及，只能硬生生的挨了这一记。

但他也极为凶悍，强忍剧痛，挥刀反击，双方再次缠斗在一起，打得难解难分。

不得不说，刘奎是一块绝佳的试金石，吴姜如有神助，越打越熟练，原本被动挨打的局面，也一点点扭转过来，开始主动反击，招式愈发凌厉。

此时，双方消耗都很大，刘奎渐渐地萌生了退意。

可是，当他想跑的时候，已经来不及了，一个不慎，被吴姜抓住破绽，一记镇魂定身印狠狠拍在胸口。

虽然只定住了他短短的三息时间，但已足够吴姜召回腰勾魂索，将他牢牢捆缚住了。

刘奎被绑，吴姜顿时松了口气，只要没有恶鬼级以上的实力，刘奎休想将勾魂索崩断。

直到此刻，吴姜才彻底放松下来，踉跄着后退一步，靠在一块墓碑上，剧烈地喘息着。

那五个老鬼，即使吴姜收回了绑着他们的勾魂索，但也没有一个敢逃跑的，老祖宗那么牛逼的存在，都被收拾了，借他们个胆子，都不敢动弹。

他受伤也不轻，气息萎靡到了极点，浑身都在微微发抖，刚才那一场激战，几乎耗尽了他所有的力气。

Chapter 92 The Old Ghost of the Qing Dynasty 2 - "The City God is my ancestor, it turns out that I am the Nth generation of gods"

Wu Jiang exerted his cultivation to the extreme, and kept throwing out the mysterious light in his left hand. Black beams of light collided with Liu Kui's scattered evil energy, making a sizzling sound and sparks flying everywhere.

For a time, the entire hill where the Liu family's ancestral tombs are located was filled with a howling wind and ghostly energy. The muffled sound of fighting was particularly harsh in the silent night, startling the night birds in the distance to flap their wings and flee.

It was another head-on fight. Wu Jiang used the reaction force to force Liu Kui back. When he was still unsteady, he flipped his hand and a pile of yellowed talismans instantly appeared in his palm. Without looking carefully at the type of talismans, he threw them towards Liu Kui.

There was a crisp crackling sound, and the talisman ignited as soon as it hit the ground. The golden talisman fire reacted violently with the black energy around Liu Kui, sending out bursts of black smoke, burning Liu Kui to let out a shrill roar, and the evil energy dissipated a bit.

Wu Jiang's eyes condensed, and he secretly accumulated strength, pouring all the mysterious light into the soul-cutting sword. The Nether Sword Qi on the sword instantly surged, glowing with a dazzling blue light.

Taking advantage of the gap between Liu Kui's sword to disperse the talisman fire, Wu Jiang dodged and stepped forward. With a soul-destroying aura in his hand, he stabbed Liu Kui's chest fiercely.

Liu Kui's pupils shrank suddenly, and it was too late to dodge, so he could only take the blow forcefully.

But he was also extremely fierce. He endured the severe pain and fought back with a knife. The two sides fought together again, and the fight was inextricable.

It has to be said that Liu Kui is an excellent touchstone. With the help of God, Wu Jiang became more and more proficient in fighting. The original situation of passive beatings was gradually reversed, and he began to take the initiative to fight back, and his moves became more and more fierce.

At this time, both sides were spending a lot of money, and Liu Kui gradually began to want to retreat.

However, when he wanted to run away, it was already too late. By accident, Wu Jiang caught the flaw and slapped him hard on the chest with a soul-stabilizing seal.

Although it only held him for a short period of three breaths, it was enough for Wu Jiang to recall the rope around his waist and bind him firmly.

Liu Kui was tied up, and Wu Jiang suddenly breathed a sigh of relief. As long as he didn't have the strength above the evil ghost level, Liu Kui would never have thought of breaking the soul hook.

It was only at this moment that Wu Jiang completely relaxed, staggered back, leaned against a tombstone, and panted violently.

Of those five old ghosts, even if Wu Jiang withdrew the rope that tied them, none of them dared to escape. The ancestors were so awesome, and they were all taken care of. Given their courage, no one dared to move.

He was badly injured, his breath was extremely weak, and his whole body was shaking slightly. The fierce battle just now had almost exhausted all his strength.
